core_obligations: Split the Gabriel quotient in two steps: since Loc(cB) is contained in cC, write the localisation cA -> cC as the composite of Q_cB with an intermediate Gabriel localisation bar Q having right adjoint bar R (proof lines 511-523).

Identify the intermediate object: put tilde E = bar R(bEC), the injective object of AB associated to the injective hull of the unit in AC, and compute tilde E = Q_cB(hEC) = hB(EC) from the construction of EC (proof line 524).

Recognise the weak-ring structure: EC is a weak ring in cT, so its image tilde E is a non-zero weak ring in AB because bar Q(tilde E) = bEC is non-zero; hence the unit is a monomorphism and, since hB(eta_cB) is the injective hull in AB, there is a split monomorphism phi from bEB to tilde E over the unit (proof lines 524-532).

Force phi to be an isomorphism: applying the exact bar Q shows bar Q(phi) is an isomorphism because bar Q(tilde E) is the injective hull in AC, so tilde E = bEB + N with bar Q(N) = 0; since tilde E lies in the image of bar R and bar R is fully faithful, N is bar R-local and hence N = bar R bar Q(N) = 0 (proof lines 532-533).
Descend to cT: the clause (it:A/C-d) of the cited proposition, applied to the intermediate quotient, produces the isomorphism in the ambient category compatible with the units (proof line 533).
proof_roadmap: Factor the localisation into two Gabriel quotients and compute the intermediate weak ring object (proof lines 511-524).

Compare injective hulls of the unit to get a split monomorphism, then use exactness and full faithfulness of the intermediate adjoint to upgrade it to an isomorphism and descend it (proof lines 524-533).
difficulty_reason: The proposition is about a proper localising tensor ideal cC containing a localising tensor ideal cB, and claims that the weak rings EB and EC attached to the two ideals are isomorphic in the ambient category in a way compatible with their unit maps (statement lines 505-508). The proof factors the Gabriel quotient into two steps and computes the intermediate object tilde E as the image of EC in the intermediate quotient, then runs an injective-hull argument: the unit is a monomorphism by a cited criterion, the injective hull of the unit in the intermediate category maps into tilde E by a split monomorphism, and exactness of the intermediate localisation together with full faithfulness of its right adjoint forces the complementary summand to vanish (proof lines 511-533). The step that carries the content is that vanishing argument, since it is what converts a split monomorphism into an isomorphism; the descent to the ambient category is then a cited clause. H2.
